decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No excavation or construction work shall be undertaken prior to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority, of a Construction Method Statement, which is certified by a qualified professional giving details of excavation, temporary works and construction techniques, including details of potential impacts on neighbouring land based on assessment of the geology and hydrology of the area.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 6 - The original decorative finials and ridge tiles shall be retained unless otherwise approved in writing by the local authority
Condition : 7 - Any windows to the flank walls at first floor or above shall be obscure glazing, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and a rear roof extension with 4 roof windows to the house and enlargement of basement and lowering of ground floor
